harness: Actual Focus, PromptBox and SessionBar in Chromium; synthetic agents on two machines with the same local agent-1. Controlled chooseOption callback, no real account or agent process.

steps: Choose Auto for Agent A (n/agent-1), leaving confirmation open.
Render Agent B (m/agent-1) in the same Focus component.
Click the surviving Switch anyway button.

final_case_assertions.cancel: Keep asking closes the confirmation, reports no command and keeps the reported Plan mode.
final_case_assertions.other-agent: The A confirmation disappears on switching to B with no command. Only a new selection and confirmation made for B emits the B callback shown in the matrix.
final_case_assertions.usage-update: Usage/context updates for A preserve A pending confirmation; confirming still targets A.
final_case_assertions.unknown-current: Mode and model both show localized Not reported placeholders and no command. Choosing Auto then opens confirmation before any command.
final_case_assertions.reported-auto: An explicitly reported Auto current mode displays accurately without a new selection or command.
final_case_assertions.safe-mode: Selecting Plan sends exactly one command to A, without a permission-skipping confirmation.
final_case_assertions.model: Selecting Model Two sends exactly one model command to A, without a mode confirmation.

limits: Controlled callback responses; these checks do not launch a real ACP agent or sign a real node grant.
Native CI status is recorded separately in the PR review.
